section.description: Other machines' screens this desktop opens through its own bridge. Passwords stay on this desktop.
section.emptyBody: Add a VNC server on your network or the internet. This desktop resolves its address once, pins it, and asks you to confirm before connecting.
section.unmanagedNote: Only sessions opened here share one controller and are audited. A VNC client that connects to the same server directly bypasses Cognia.
section.noViewOnly: Full control only (cannot be made read-only)
section.deleteBody: Its stored passwords are removed from this desktop and any open session to it ends.
section.descriptionRemote: Other machines' screens {host} opens through its bridge. Passwords stay on {host}.
section.emptyBodyRemote: Add a VNC server that {host} can reach. {host} resolves its address once, pins it, and asks you to confirm before connecting.
section.deleteBodyRemote: Its stored passwords are removed from {host} and any open session to it ends.
section.hostOutdated: {host} cannot broker remote desktops yet. Update it to open them from here.

dialog.description: Cognia connects to the server from this desktop and passes an already-authenticated stream to the viewer.
dialog.noProviders: No remote desktop provider is enabled. Enable the VNC provider plugin in Plugins.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.confirmPrivate: This is a device on your local network ({ip}). Cognia will only ever connect to this address; if the name later points elsewhere you will be asked again.
dialog.confirmPublic: This address is on the internet ({ip}). VNC traffic is not encrypted: anyone on the path can see the screen and what you type.
dialog.unsupported: This server offers security types {types}. Cognia supports None (1) and VNC password (2) only.
dialog.requiresPassword: The server requires a VNC password.
dialog.noPasswordNeeded: The server accepts connections without a password.
dialog.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored password
dialog.passwordTruncation: VNC uses only the first 8 characters of a password.
dialog.viewOnlyLabel: The server has a separate view-only password
dialog.viewOnlyDescription: TigerVNC (vncpasswd) and x11vnc (-viewpasswd) enforce it. Without one, this desktop can only be opened with full control.
dialog.noAuthReadOnly: A server without a password cannot be opened read-only.
dialog.savedWithoutPassword: Saved, but the password could not be stored: {message}
dialog.addressChanged: The address changed. Check it again before saving.
dialog.required: Fill in a name, host and port, and check the address.
dialog.descriptionRemote: Cognia connects to the server from {host} and passes an already-authenticated stream to this viewer. The password is sent to {host} once and never shown again.
dialog.confirmPrivateRemote: This is a device on {host}'s local network ({ip}). {host} will only ever connect to this address; if the name later points elsewhere you will be asked again.
